strings.complex_move_time_easing_help: Choose X and Y easing from the 29 named types. Enable custom easing windows to limit each curve to a slice.
strings.complex_move_preview_description: Live Complex Move path preview, colored green at the start and red at the end

strings.curve_notes_density_help: Active beat-grid step: 1/%1$d. Density 1 fills every step; higher values create a finer curve.

strings.hitsound_file_unavailable: Choose a built-in sound or an existing audio file from this chart package.
strings.field_event_easing_help: Choose a curve by name and preview its shape. Speed always uses Linear; custom Bézier overrides the selected curve.
strings.field_event_easing_preview_description: Orange graph showing progress from start to finish for the selected curve

strings.event_split_applied_exact: Event split at the exact playhead position

strings.event_pass_invalid: Pass would create an invalid value and was not applied
strings.event_rand_applied: Rand set the event tail to %1$s
strings.event_rand_invalid: Rand could not create a valid value for this event
strings.event_glue_applied: Previous event end value glued into the selected event start
strings.event_glue_no_change: The selected event is already glued to the previous value
strings.storyboard_scope: Active target: line %1$d, %2$s · RPE extended events
strings.storyboard_chart_required: Open a chart before editing storyboard events
strings.storyboard_time_help: Times accept exact whole:numerator/denominator notation or decimal beats.
strings.storyboard_help_generic: Storyboard events are stored in the active line’s RPE extended structure and support the same timing and easing controls as normal events.
strings.storyboard_help_scale_x: Controls horizontal scale. The manual-defined neutral value is 1.0; negative values mirror the visual.
strings.storyboard_help_scale_y: Controls vertical scale. The manual-defined neutral value is 1.0; negative values mirror the visual.
strings.storyboard_help_color: Controls line, texture, paint and text tint. Tap a color button to open the palette.
strings.storyboard_help_paint: Controls brush radius. Zero disables painting; a negative value clears the accumulated canvas at that time.
strings.storyboard_help_text: Controls displayed text. Prefix growth is animated; numeric endpoints containing %P% interpolate as numbers.
strings.storyboard_help_incline: Controls simulated X-axis incline in degrees. RPE does not apply incline to Hold notes.
strings.storyboard_help_gif: Controls the progress of an animated custom line texture while this event is active.
strings.storyboard_delete_message: Delete the %1$s event starting at %2$s? Undo remains available.
strings.storyboard_glued: Previous end value glued into this event’s start
strings.storyboard_split_applied: Storyboard event split at the current snapped beat
strings.storyboard_no_previous: No previous storyboard event of this type is available
strings.storyboard_glue_no_change: This event already starts at the previous event’s end value
strings.storyboard_split_inside: Move the playhead strictly inside the selected storyboard event
strings.storyboard_invalid_time: The duplicated time interval is outside the supported beat range
strings.storyboard_text_required: Text event values cannot be null

strings.bpm_validation_duplicate: A BPM change already starts at this beat

strings.settings_invalid: Check all Settings values: ranges, RGB color, dimensions and hotkey chords

strings.event_clone_invalid_profile: Check the offset values, variation and repeating multipliers
strings.event_clone_too_many: Event Clone is limited to 4096 generated events. Select fewer source events or destination lines.

strings.event_clone_invalid_result: The copies contain invalid times or values. Check the timing, offsets and variation.
strings.field_line_hud: HUD element controlled by this line
strings.field_line_hud_help: Bind a HUD element, then edit this line’s Move X/Y, Rotate, Alpha, Scale X/Y and Color events. Position is added to the original HUD position; the line itself is hidden. Enable the in-game UI in preview to see the result.
strings.settings_tap_to_seek: Seek time by tapping a beatmap

strings.video_bitrate_hint: Higher bitrate preserves detail and increases file size. 12 Mbps is a good starting point for 1080p.
strings.video_range_hint: Times follow the music / Preview timeline; chart and package offsets apply automatically.

strings.video_hud: Show score, combo and chart HUD

strings.video_enter_numbers: Enter numeric values in all video and time fields.

strings.event_subdivide_invalid: Select normal events on layers 0–3 with valid times and a positive beat-grid division.
strings.batch_curve_help: Apply this full curve to every selected event of the chosen type, replacing custom Bézier and curve windows. Event times and values stay the same.
strings.clone_choose_hint: Choose the lines that will receive copies.
strings.clone_order_help: Copies follow the order below. Use ↑ and ↓ to change it.
strings.clone_search_lines: Find a line by name or number
strings.clone_line_limit: Select up to 256 lines. Use search to narrow the list.
strings.clone_delay_help: The first line keeps the original time. Positive shifts place each following line later; negative shifts place it earlier. Use a decimal or a fraction such as 0:1/4.
strings.clone_offset_help: Offsets are added to both ends of the copied events. A gradual offset changes from the first destination line to the last; its curve controls this progression.
strings.clone_variation_help: Multipliers repeat in destination order: 1 -1 alternates the offset direction. Variation adds a random amount before multiplying. Preview and Apply use the same random values.
strings.clone_preview_copy: Original events stay on the source line.
strings.clone_preview_move: Original events will be removed from the source line.
strings.clone_preserved_help: Copies preserve the original durations and curves. One Undo reverses the whole operation.
strings.clone_source_changed: The source selection changed. Reopen Event Clone for the new selection.
